convention.field: idealized free-field equivalent; no enclosure attenuation or room reflections
convention.listener: one fixed hypothetical listener 1 m from common source reference; component locations collapsed to that reference
convention.directivity: Each admitted model profile is assumed to represent this listener. No measured directivity conversion is claimed; transfers carry explicit assumption bands. Bare fan reference is intake-facing; cooler/pump effective orientation is an assumption.
convention.background: excluded; modeled source-only energy. Source floors are not added once per source.
convention.independence: incoherent broadband source-energy approximation; no phase/coherence, beating or tonal model

aggregation.fanCount: packQuantity*unitsPerPack, integer physical units; use installedCount if selection explicitly distinguishes purchased and installed
aggregation.coolerCount: one selected complete assembly, with all internal rotating sources included once
aggregation.bands: sum all low energies, all central energies, all high energies separately; systematic assumptions do not average away with fan count
aggregation.interpolation: merge rpmNodes + additionalRpmNodes, sort by physical RPM, interpolate energy separately for each bound; 50-100% rated RPM only in v1
aggregation.zero: zero units or explicitly stopped source contributes zero energy, never0dBA; AIO pump/VRM do not stop with radiator fan
aggregation.unknown: subtotal may be returned only as partial, naming each selected omitted source; no hidden fallback

disclosure: Ruído simulado do cooler e das ventoinhas selecionadas, a1m. Perfis aproximados; não inclui GPU, fonte, armazenamento, ventoinhas do gabinete não selecionadas nem ruído ambiente.
